components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A short hint. Variant × Direction = 8 variants. Mandatory only on icon-only buttons.

components.name: Tooltip callout

Text.default: Some hints need two lines to explain what this does

components.description: Tooltip callout — a pointed hint that explains a new or hidden feature next to its trigger, with an optional action ("Got it"). Bubble tail in 6 positions. Always dark (fixed Dark mode, surface/raised). One per screen; dismiss on action or tap outside. For hover labels use Tooltip.

Why the Dark variant changes with the mode
The Dark variant is bound to the gray/1000 token. It is black in Light mode and white in Dark mode. This is deliberate: a tooltip must always contrast with the background.
